test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible conclusions I and II. Read the information carefully and select the correct option.

**Statement:**

Country B has been importing 80% of its crude oil and petroleum from country Y for a few decades now to fulfil their fuel needs. However, owing to the current financial crisis in country Y, it exports the crude oil and petroleum to other countries at 30% higher prices now.

Which of the following can be concluded from the given information?

I. The car resale industry in country B will be on verge of a total shut down in the coming months.

II. Country B will increase fuel tax by 30%.

options.text: Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information.
Only I can be concluded from the given information.
Both I and II can be concluded from the given information.
Only II can be concluded from the given information.

solution:
**Statement: **Country B has been importing 80% of its crude oil and petroleum from country Y for a few decades now to fulfil their fuel needs. However, owing to the current financial crisis in country Y, it exports the crude oil and petroleum to other countries at 30% higher prices now.

Conclusion I: The car resale industry in country B will be on verge of a total shut down in the coming months **- False**

(This is not the permanent solution, As, Country B has been importing 80% of its crude oil and petroleum from country Y for a few decades now to fulfil their fuel needs. So, it will not shut down in the coming months and also not mentioned in the statement) 

So, Conclusion I does not follow.

**Conclusion II: **Country B will increase fuel tax by 30%** - False**

(This is not the permanent solution, As, it exports the crude oil and petroleum to other countries at 30% higher prices now as mentioned in the statement).

So, Conclusion II does not follow.

Thus,** 'Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information'**.
